:::{#exr-poisson-zero-conditional}
#### Conditional probability of a zero given the Poisson sum

Let $\dsn{X} \siid \Pois(\rate)$ and $S \eqdef \sumin \Rvar_\iobs$.
Find $\Pr\paren{X_1 = 0 \given S = t}$ for each $t = 0, 1, 2, \ldots$.
You may use that $S \sim \Pois(n\rate)$, by
[the sum of independent Poisson variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/distributions.html#thm-sum-pois) and induction on $n$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-poisson-zero-conditional}

The event $X_1 = 0$ and $S = t$ happens exactly when $X_1 = 0$ and $X_2 + \cdots + X_n = t$,
and $X_2 + \cdots + X_n \sim \Pois\paren{(n-1)\rate}$ is independent of $X_1$.

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Pr\paren{X_1 = 0 \given S = t}
&= \frac{\Pr\paren{X_1 = 0,\ S = t}}{\Pr\paren{S = t}}
&& \text{(conditional probability)}\\
&= \frac{\Pr\paren{X_1 = 0,\ X_2 + \cdots + X_n = t}}{\Pr\paren{S = t}}
&& \text{(on $X_1 = 0$, $S$ is that sum)}\\
&= \frac{\Pr\paren{X_1 = 0} \Pr\paren{X_2 + \cdots + X_n = t}}{\Pr\paren{S = t}}
&& \text{(independence)}\\
&= \frac{e^{-\rate} \cdot e^{-(n-1)\rate} \paren{(n-1)\rate}^t / t!}{e^{-n\rate} \paren{n\rate}^t / t!}
&& \text{(Poisson mass functions)}\\
&= \frac{e^{-n\rate} \paren{(n-1)\rate}^t / t!}{e^{-n\rate} \paren{n\rate}^t / t!}
&& \text{($e^{-\rate} e^{-(n-1)\rate} = e^{-n\rate}$)}\\
&= \frac{\paren{(n-1)\rate}^t}{\paren{n\rate}^t}
&& \text{(cancel $e^{-n\rate} / t!$)}\\
&= \paren{\frac{n-1}{n}}^t
&& \text{(cancel $\rate^t$, combine powers)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
